svg.aria-label: One layer, two ways to compute it, from Transformers are SSMs (Mamba-2, 2024). Left, the parallel form: a lower-triangular N by N matrix M with queries on the rows and keys on the columns, entry M_ij = (a_{j+1} ⋯ a_i)(q_i · k_j), zero above the diagonal, and y = M v. It is a structured, semiseparable mask and trains like attention in one big matmul. Right, the recurrent form: a chain of constant-size states, h_t = a_t h_{t−1} + k_t v_tᵀ, read as y_t = h_tᵀ q_t, which decodes like an RNN; in SSM names k = B, v = x, q = C. A double arrow says they give the same numbers. Below, how it is actually computed: the sequence is split into chunks, the diagonal blocks of M are small attention inside each chunk with dense matmuls, and the off-diagonal blocks are low rank and passed through the state h carried from chunk to chunk. A red note: softmax attention is not in this family, the mask has to have this structure, so it does not mean softmax equals a constant-size SSM.
